concerns.text: The Constitution (III) requires every dataset to be checksummed. T001 creates `data/processed/base_template.csv` but no task records its SHA‑256 checksum. Add a task (e.g., T015) that runs `python code/scripts/record_hashes.py data/processed/base_template.csv` and records the hash in `state/artifact_hashes.yaml`.

T012 only records checksums for files under `data/results/`. To satisfy Constitution III, checksums must be recorded for *all* final artefacts, including those in `data/processed/`. Extend T012 (or add a complementary task) to also checksum `data/processed/base_template.csv`.
